A read-only project probe also loaded the pinned 2 MiB original ROM, exposed the expected $20000-byte WRAM and $10000-byte VRAM spaces, reported initial PC $00:8001, and captured one decoded frame. bsnes-plus remains available for interactive debugger and visual-viewer cross-checks.
